Vintage matched 14K gold ring and screw back earrings with bold oval pearly grey cabochons set in decorative pierced gold surrounds. The cabochons are likely mabe pearl, which is a genuine cultured pearl dome that is filled and backed with mother of pearl. The set has a distinctive mid century look with substantial gold work and softly iridescent centers. Ring is approximately size 7 as shown.
Ring and earrings are marked 4K, except one earring is marked 14K, likely a striking error. The ring tests at 13.20K gold, and earrings test at 13.03K gold in our Thermo Fisher XRF metal testers. See photos for measurements and condition details.
